description: The UX quality rubric (FEAT-018 GDL-37 to GDL-39, SD-006): nine dimensions, never averaged; task effectiveness and accessibility are baselines. Statements are ux-builder's own words; sources are paraphrased (ADR-025 rule 7).

dimensions.name: Task effectiveness
dimensions.question: Can users accomplish their goals?
measures: every journey walkable over the flow (journey.walkable)
every task realized by a journey (task.realized)

sources.title: ISO 9241-11:2018 Ergonomics of human-system interaction, Part 11: Usability: definitions and concepts

dimensions.name: Task efficiency
dimensions.question: How much effort does a task take?

sources.title: ISO 9241-11:2018 Ergonomics of human-system interaction, Part 11: Usability: definitions and concepts

dimensions.name: Cognitive load
dimensions.question: How much must users understand or remember?

sources.title: Nielsen Norman Group: Minimize Cognitive Load to Maximize Usability

dimensions.name: Discoverability
dimensions.question: Can users find the functionality they need?
measures: observed share who found the feature

sources.title: Nielsen Norman Group: Usability 101: Introduction to Usability

dimensions.name: Learnability
dimensions.question: Can first-time users understand the interface?

sources.title: Nielsen Norman Group: Usability 101: Introduction to Usability
Nielsen Norman Group: 10 Usability Heuristics for User Interface Design (4, Consistency and standards)

dimensions.name: Accessibility
dimensions.question: Can users with different abilities complete their tasks?
measures: audit errors (WCAG 2.2 and the interaction rules)

dimensions.name: Error recovery
dimensions.question: Can users easily recover from mistakes?
measures: screens that declare an error state

sources.title: Nielsen Norman Group: 10 Usability Heuristics for User Interface Design (9, Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors)

dimensions.name: User confidence
dimensions.question: Do users understand what the system is doing?

sources.title: Nielsen Norman Group: 10 Usability Heuristics for User Interface Design (1, Visibility of system status)
